title: Handoff Document v1.1
description: Structured handoff emitted by an agent at the end of any task (handoff-first; an HTML report artifact is optional). Validates the handoff contract between pipeline stages.

schema_version.description: Schema version identifier. Use 'handoff-v1.1' for new handoffs.

agent.description: Name of the agent that produced this handoff (e.g. 'software-engineer').

produced_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the handoff was produced.

scope.description: Scope descriptor for the handoff (e.g. file path, module, component).

metrics.description: Key quantitative metrics for this handoff (e.g. token counts, file counts).

path.description: Relative path from workspace root to the artifact file. Supports {context} and {run_ts} templates. Omitted in v1.1 handoff-first (no-report) emission; when present, content_hash must accompany it.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the artifact file content. Required whenever path is present — `dadaia reports validate` recomputes the file hash and fails on mismatch or absence.

detail_md.description: Extended markdown detail on the finding.

fix_recommendation.description: Concrete fix recommendation for this finding.

findings.description: Optional list of key findings from the agent's work.

decisions_required.description: Optional list of decisions or open questions the next agent or operator must resolve.

agent.description: Name of the next agent in the pipeline.

expected_artifact_type.description: Expected artifact type from the next agent.

next_handoff.description: Optional pointer to the expected next handoff in the pipeline.

verdict.description: Optional approval verdict emitted by qa-engineer or security-reviewer. When present, must be APPROVED or REJECTED. Enables machine-checkable dual-approval gate at release CLOSURE.

verdict_reason.description: Optional human-readable summary explaining the verdict.
